name: One Pump Chump
source:
One Pump Chump is a lewd parody Visual Novel with RPG elements, set in a world of powerful heroines, horny monster girls, and hero rankings. Train, flirt, survive... and try not to blow it too early.​

[From F95Zone]
translation:
《One Pump Chump》是一款带有RPG元素的猥亵模仿视觉小说，背景设定在一个充满强大女主角、饥渴怪物女孩和英雄排名的世界中。训练、调情、生存……尽量不要过早地失败。​

[来自F95Zone]
